browser_observations: Public Site v11, in-app Chromium pane: WebGL context lost right after deploying Operation 1 (white page, CanvasShaderGLES3 compile failure); the pane then disabled WebGL2 for that origin.
Pre-fix local export: a second attempt deployed without context loss, so the failure is intermittent rather than deterministic.
Post-fix local export: title, briefing and Operation 1 deployment rendered; isContextLost() == false after combat start.
